description: This file is a shell script that configures Wi-Fi mesh backhaul interfaces, bridges, and related network settings based on device model and mode. It contains functions for setting up bridges, VLANs, and backhaul configurations, with numerous conditional behaviors tailored for specific device models and modes.

methods.name: mesh_bridges
methods.description: Sets up Wi-Fi interfaces into bridges by disabling and re-adding WLAN interfaces to specified bridge interfaces, and configuring IP addresses and iptables for the bridges.

methods.name: mesh_bhaul
methods.description: Creates and configures a backhaul bridge for Ethernet Pod connections, including iptables configuration.

methods.name: is_vlan
methods.description: Checks whether a given network interface is a VLAN interface.

methods.name: vlan_root
methods.description: Extracts the root interface name from a VLAN interface name.

methods.name: bridge_interfaces
methods.description: Lists all interfaces associated with a given bridge, excluding STP.

methods.name: bridge_set_mtu
methods.description: Sets the MTU for a bridge and all its member interfaces.

methods.name: mesh_bridge_setup
methods.description: Sets up bridge interfaces for mesh backhaul, including MTU and IP configuration.

methods.name: mesh_bridge_ip
methods.description: Configures the IP address and netmask for a specified interface.
